location: Results > Exercise Duration, Stage 2 3 (Condition) x 2 (Sex) ANOVA and Newman-Keuls post hoc test (p. 5)
quote: A Newman-Keuls post hoc test indicated that this effect was significantly smaller (34.1s) in the Partner-with-encouragement condition.
reason: Source identity (Irwin, Feltz, & Kerr, 2013, JMIR 15(6):e104, doi:10.2196/jmir.2551) and target contrast are confirmed. At the located Stage 2 3 (Condition) x 2 (Sex) ANOVA on Block 2 - Block 1 exercise-duration difference scores (p. 5), the Newman-Keuls post hoc comparison between Partner-without-encouragement (estimated marginal mean 53.63s, SD 58.44) and Partner-with-encouragement (19.49s, SD 59.30s) prints a 34.1s difference (53.63 - 19.49 = 34.14s, vs. 31.14s in the abstract), with no standardized pairwise effect size reported and es_type_o unspecified.
